observations: Photos show multiple used car tires stacked in a tire shop setting.
Tire sidewalls show large molded markings (appears like size text such as '175/70' and other numbers), but no clear brand/model name is readable in the provided images.
No close-up tread depth measurement, tread wear bars, or damage close-ups (cuts/tears) are shown.
No photo shows the tire being inflated, nor any clear evidence of 'no patch' or 'no bulge'.
No single tire is clearly isolated with a clear view of the full circumference.

claims.evidence: Brand/origin 'Belgium' is not readable/confirmable from the photos provided.
No tread-depth measurement, wear-bar comparison, or close-up tread photos to support '90 percent'.
No close-up of the inner sidewall/tread area showing absence of patches.
No close-up sidewall inspection or inflation/straight-on bulge check shown.
No documentation (invoice/vehicle year proof) and no photo evidence tying tires to a 2023 vehicle.

risks.risk: Tread depth may be significantly less than claimed (90% not verifiable from photos).
risks.proof: One close-up photo of the tread with a ruler/coin for scale OR a tread-depth gauge reading (mm) at 3 points per tire.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used tires with unknown tread (worst case: not near 90% tread).

risks.risk: Possible prior repair (patch/plug) not visible in wide stacked photos.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the inner tread surface and inner sidewall for each tire, taken under bright light.
risks.if_unproven: Price as patched/repair-uncertain tires (worst case: assume repair).

risks.risk: Sidewall bulges/cuts may exist but are not clearly shown.
risks.proof: Straight-on sidewall close-ups of each tire (both sides), plus a short clip while rotating the tire to show any bulge.
risks.if_unproven: Price as tires with potential sidewall issues (worst case: treat as not guaranteed defect-free).

risks.risk: Exact tire size and whether these are the same size/model is unclear from the photos.
risks.proof: Photo of the full sidewall text for each tire (size code clearly readable) and confirm quantity/size match.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic used tires with size/model not guaranteed.

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up of the tire sidewall text (full size code) for the exact tire(s) being sold.
Send tread-depth measurements (mm) at 3 points per tire, or a photo with a ruler/coin for scale.
Send close-up photos of the inner tread area and inner sidewall to confirm 'no patch'.
Send close-up photos (both sides) of each tire sidewall and a short rotation video to confirm 'no bulge'.
Confirm quantity: how many tires exactly and whether all are the same size.
response.reason: The photos do not provide verifiable evidence for the key pricing drivers (tread depth, patch/repair status, and bulge/defect-free condition), and the brand/origin claim is not readable.
